('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'medium', 'moderate').source:
IN R0           ; R0 = n

    ; Handle base cases
    JZ R0, BASE0    ; if n == 0, output 0
    MOV R1, 1
    JZ R1, BASE1    ; never, placeholder
    ; Check if n == 1
    MOV R2, 1
    SUB R2, R0      ; R2 = 1 - n
    JZ R2, BASE1    ; if n == 1, output 1

    ; General case: iterative fibonacci
    ; R1 = fib(i-1) = 0 (fib(0))
    ; R2 = fib(i)   = 1 (fib(1))
    ; R3 = counter, starts at 1, goes up to n
    ; R4 = modulus = 1000000007

    MOV R1, 0       ; fib(0)
    MOV R2, 1       ; fib(1)
    MOV R3, 1       ; counter = 1
    MOV R4, 1000000007

LOOP:
    ; if counter == n, we're done
    MOV R5, R3
    SUB R5, R0      ; R5 = counter - n
    JZ R5, DONE

    ; compute next fib
    MOV R6, R2      ; R6 = fib(i)
    ADD R6, R1      ; R6 = fib(i) + fib(i-1)
    MOD R6, R4      ; R6 = fib(i+1) % MOD

    MOV R1, R2      ; fib(i-1) = fib(i)
    MOV R2, R6      ; fib(i) = fib(i+1)

    INC R3          ; counter++
    JMP LOOP

DONE:
    OUT R2
    HALT

BASE0:
    OUT 0
    HALT

BASE1:
    OUT 1
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(1)', 'small', 'simple').source:
; Read n into R0
    IN R0

    ; R1 = a = fib(0) = 0
    ; R2 = b = fib(1) = 1
    ; R3 = modulus
    ; R4 = loop counter (counts down from n to 0)
    ; Use a count-down loop with a different structure

    MOV R1, 0
    MOV R2, 1
    MOV R3, 1000000007
    MOV R4, R0      ; R4 = n (countdown)

    ; If n == 0, output 0 immediately
    JZ R4, OUT0

    ; Loop: we do n iterations, each time:
    ;   temp = a + b
    ;   a = b
    ;   b = temp % MOD
    ; After n iterations, a = fib(n)
    ; Start: a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    ; After 1 iter: a=1, b=1  => a=fib(1)
    ; After 2 iter: a=1, b=2  => a=fib(2)
    ; So after n iters, a = fib(n)

LOOP:
    MOV R5, R1      ; R5 = a
    ADD R5, R2      ; R5 = a + b
    MOD R5, R3      ; R5 = (a+b) % MOD
    MOV R1, R2      ; a = b
    MOV R2, R5      ; b = new value
    DEC R4          ; countdown--
    JNZ R4, LOOP    ; if not zero, continue

    OUT R1          ; output a = fib(n)
    HALT

OUT0:
    OUT 0
    HALT

('O(n)', 'O(n)', 'medium', 'moderate').source:
; Fibonacci using memory to store the sequence
; Store fib values in memory, then read fib(n) from memory
; This uses a memory-based approach rather than register-only iteration

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R1, 1000000007  ; modulus

    ; Store fib(0) and fib(1) in memory
    MOV R2, 0
    STOR R2, [R2+0]     ; mem[0] = 0 = fib(0)
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R2+1]     ; mem[1] = 1 = fib(1)

    ; If n == 0, output mem[0] = 0
    JZ R0, OUTPUT

    ; If n == 1, output mem[1] = 1
    MOV R4, 1
    MOV R5, R0
    SUB R5, 1
    JZ R5, OUTPUT

    ; Build fib table from index 2 up to n
    ; R3 = current index, starts at 2
    MOV R3, 2

BUILDLOOP:
    ; if R3 > R0, done building
    JGT R3, R0, OUTPUT

    ; mem[R3] = (mem[R3-1] + mem[R3-2]) % MOD
    MOV R4, R3
    SUB R4, 1
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]     ; R5 = mem[R3-1]

    MOV R4, R3
    SUB R4, 2
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]     ; R6 = mem[R3-2]

    ADD R5, R6          ; R5 = fib(R3-1) + fib(R3-2)
    MOD R5, R1          ; R5 %= MOD

    STOR R5, [R3+0]     ; mem[R3] = R5

    INC R3
    JMP BUILDLOOP

OUTPUT:
    ; Output mem[n]
    LOAD R7, [R0+0]
    OUT R7
    HALT

('O(log n)', 'O(log n)', 'large', 'moder.source:
; Fibonacci using matrix exponentiation approach (iterative doubling method)
; fib(2k)   = fib(k) * (2*fib(k+1) - fib(k))
; fib(2k+1) = fib(k)^2 + fib(k+1)^2
; This is O(log n) time, fundamentally different from all previous O(n) iterative solutions

; We'll use a recursive-style stack simulation stored in memory
; Stack stores bits of n (LSB to MSB), then we process from MSB to LSB

    IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R6, 1000000007  ; R6 = MOD

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUTZERO

    MOV R1, R0
    SUB R1, 1
    JZ R1, OUTONE

    ; Extract bits of n and store them in memory (LSB first)
    ; mem[0], mem[1], ... = bits from LSB to MSB
    MOV R1, R0          ; R1 = n (working copy)
    MOV R2, 0           ; R2 = bit index / count

EXTRACT:
    JZ R1, EXTRACTED
    MOV R3, R1
    MOD R3, 2           ; R3 = R1 % 2 (LSB)
    STOR R3, [R2+0]     ; mem[R2] = bit
    INC R2
    DIV R1, 2           ; R1 >>= 1
    JMP EXTRACT

EXTRACTED:
    ; R2 = number of bits stored
    ; Process from MSB (index R2-1) down to 0
    ; Start with a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R3, 0           ; R3 = a = fib(k)
    MOV R4, 1           ; R4 = b = fib(k+1)

    ; Start from MSB: index = R2-1
    DEC R2              ; R2 = index of MSB

BITLOOP:
    ; Doubling step:
    ; c = a * (2*b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    ; a = c, b = d

    ; Compute 2*b - a
    MOV R5, R4
    MUL R5, 2           ; R5 = 2*b
    SUB R5, R3          ; R5 = 2*b - a
    MOD R5, R6          ; R5 %= MOD

    ; Compute c = a * (2*b - a) mod MOD
    MOV R7, R3
    MUL R7, R5          ; R7 = a * (2*b - a)
    MOD R7, R6          ; R7 = c = fib(2k)

    ; Compute d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    MOV R5, R3
    MUL R5, R3          ; R5 = a*a
    MOD R5, R6
    MOV R1, R4
    MUL R1, R4          ; R1 = b*b
    MOD R1, R6
    ADD R5, R1          ; R5 = a*a + b*b
    MOD R5, R6          ; R5 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; a = c, b = d
    MOV R3, R7
    MOV R4, R5

    ; Check current bit
    LOAD R1, [R2+0]     ; R1 = bit at index R2
    JZ R1, BITISZERO

    ; Bit is 1: advance one step
    ; new_a = b, new_b = a + b
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4          ; R5 = a + b
    MOD R5, R6
    MOV R3, R4          ; a = b
    MOV R4, R5          ; b = a + b

BITISZERO:
    ; Move to next bit (going toward LSB)
    JZ R2, DONE
    DEC R2
    JMP BITLOOP

DONE:
    OUT R3
    HALT

OUTZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUTONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci using memory to store the sequence
; Store fib values in memory, then read fib(n) from memory
; This uses a memory-based approach rather than register-only iteration

    IN R0           ; R0 = n
    MOV R1, 1000000007  ; modulus

    ; Store fib(0) and fib(1) in memory
    MOV R2, 0
    STOR R2, [R2+0]     ; mem[0] = 0 = fib(0)
    MOV R3, 1
    STOR R3, [R2+1]     ; mem[1] = 1 = fib(1)

    ; If n == 0, output mem[0] = 0
    JZ R0, OUTPUT

    ; If n == 1, output mem[1] = 1
    MOV R4, 1
    MOV R5, R0
    SUB R5, 1
    JZ R5, OUTPUT

    ; Build fib table from index 2 up to n
    ; R3 = current index, starts at 2
    MOV R3, 2

BUILDLOOP:
    ; if R3 > R0, done building
    JGT R3, R0, OUTPUT

    ; mem[R3] = (mem[R3-1] + mem[R3-2]) % MOD
    MOV R4, R3
    SUB R4, 1
    LOAD R5, [R4+0]     ; R5 = mem[R3-1]

    MOV R4, R3
    SUB R4, 2
    LOAD R6, [R4+0]     ; R6 = mem[R3-2]

    ADD R5, R6          ; R5 = fib(R3-1) + fib(R3-2)
    MOD R5, R1          ; R5 %= MOD

    STOR R5, [R3+0]     ; mem[R3] = R5

    INC R3
    JMP BUILDLOOP

OUTPUT:
    ; Output mem[n]
    LOAD R7, [R0+0]
    OUT R7
    HALT

; Fibonacci using a sliding window with two memory cells
; and a forward-counting loop that steps by 2 each iteration
; (unrolled style: do two fib steps per loop iteration)

    IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R4, 1000000007  ; R4 = MOD

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUTZERO      ; n == 0 -> output 0

    MOV R5, R0
    SUB R5, 1
    JZ R5, OUTONE       ; n == 1 -> output 1

    MOV R5, R0
    SUB R5, 2
    JZ R5, OUTONE       ; n == 2 -> output 1

    ; General iterative case
    ; We'll use two memory slots:
    ;   mem[0] = fib(even index)
    ;   mem[1] = fib(odd index)
    ; Start: mem[0]=fib(0)=0, mem[1]=fib(1)=1
    ; Each full loop iteration advances by 2:
    ;   new_even = old_even + old_odd  (mod)
    ;   new_odd  = new_even + old_odd  (mod)
    ; Counter R3 starts at 2, increments by 2, until >= n

    MOV R1, 0
    STOR R1, [R1+0]     ; mem[0] = 0
    MOV R2, 1
    STOR R2, [R1+1]     ; mem[1] = 1

    MOV R3, 2           ; R3 = current index (starts at 2)

LOOP2:
    ; Load current even and odd fib values
    MOV R6, 0
    LOAD R1, [R6+0]     ; R1 = fib(even)
    LOAD R2, [R6+1]     ; R2 = fib(odd)

    ; Step 1: compute fib(even+2) = fib(even) + 2*fib(odd) ... 
    ; Actually: fib(i) = fib(i-2) + fib(i-1)
    ; fib(R3) = fib(R3-2) + fib(R3-1) = R1 + R2
    MOV R5, R1
    ADD R5, R2
    MOD R5, R4          ; R5 = fib(R3) = new even

    ; Check if R3 == n
    MOV R7, R3
    SUB R7, R0
    JZ R7, OUTEVEN      ; if R3 == n, output R5

    ; Step 2: fib(R3+1) = fib(R3) + fib(R3-1) = R5 + R2
    MOV R1, R5
    ADD R1, R2
    MOD R1, R4          ; R1 = fib(R3+1) = new odd

    ; Check if R3+1 == n
    MOV R7, R3
    ADD R7, 1
    SUB R7, R0
    JZ R7, OUTODD       ; if R3+1 == n, output R1

    ; Store updated values back to memory
    MOV R6, 0
    STOR R5, [R6+0]     ; mem[0] = fib(R3)
    STOR R1, [R6+1]     ; mem[1] = fib(R3+1)

    ADD R3, 2
    JMP LOOP2

OUTEVEN:
    OUT R5
    HALT

OUTODD:
    OUT R1
    HALT

OUTZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUTONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

; Fibonacci using matrix exponentiation approach (iterative doubling method)
; fib(2k)   = fib(k) * (2*fib(k+1) - fib(k))
; fib(2k+1) = fib(k)^2 + fib(k+1)^2
; This is O(log n) time, fundamentally different from all previous O(n) iterative solutions

; We'll use a recursive-style stack simulation stored in memory
; Stack stores bits of n (LSB to MSB), then we process from MSB to LSB

    IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R6, 1000000007  ; R6 = MOD

    ; Base cases
    JZ R0, OUTZERO

    MOV R1, R0
    SUB R1, 1
    JZ R1, OUTONE

    ; Extract bits of n and store them in memory (LSB first)
    ; mem[0], mem[1], ... = bits from LSB to MSB
    MOV R1, R0          ; R1 = n (working copy)
    MOV R2, 0           ; R2 = bit index / count

EXTRACT:
    JZ R1, EXTRACTED
    MOV R3, R1
    MOD R3, 2           ; R3 = R1 % 2 (LSB)
    STOR R3, [R2+0]     ; mem[R2] = bit
    INC R2
    DIV R1, 2           ; R1 >>= 1
    JMP EXTRACT

EXTRACTED:
    ; R2 = number of bits stored
    ; Process from MSB (index R2-1) down to 0
    ; Start with a=fib(0)=0, b=fib(1)=1
    MOV R3, 0           ; R3 = a = fib(k)
    MOV R4, 1           ; R4 = b = fib(k+1)

    ; Start from MSB: index = R2-1
    DEC R2              ; R2 = index of MSB

BITLOOP:
    ; Doubling step:
    ; c = a * (2*b - a) mod MOD
    ; d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    ; a = c, b = d

    ; Compute 2*b - a
    MOV R5, R4
    MUL R5, 2           ; R5 = 2*b
    SUB R5, R3          ; R5 = 2*b - a
    MOD R5, R6          ; R5 %= MOD

    ; Compute c = a * (2*b - a) mod MOD
    MOV R7, R3
    MUL R7, R5          ; R7 = a * (2*b - a)
    MOD R7, R6          ; R7 = c = fib(2k)

    ; Compute d = a*a + b*b mod MOD
    MOV R5, R3
    MUL R5, R3          ; R5 = a*a
    MOD R5, R6
    MOV R1, R4
    MUL R1, R4          ; R1 = b*b
    MOD R1, R6
    ADD R5, R1          ; R5 = a*a + b*b
    MOD R5, R6          ; R5 = d = fib(2k+1)

    ; a = c, b = d
    MOV R3, R7
    MOV R4, R5

    ; Check current bit
    LOAD R1, [R2+0]     ; R1 = bit at index R2
    JZ R1, BITISZERO

    ; Bit is 1: advance one step
    ; new_a = b, new_b = a + b
    MOV R5, R3
    ADD R5, R4          ; R5 = a + b
    MOD R5, R6
    MOV R3, R4          ; a = b
    MOV R4, R5          ; b = a + b

BITISZERO:
    ; Move to next bit (going toward LSB)
    JZ R2, DONE
    DEC R2
    JMP BITLOOP

DONE:
    OUT R3
    HALT

OUTZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUTONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT

records.source:
IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R5, 1000000007  ; R5 = MOD

    ; Store fib values in a rotating buffer of size 3 in memory
    ; mem[0]=0, mem[1]=1, mem[2]=1 initially (fib(0),fib(1),fib(2))
    ; Then for i>=3: mem[i%3] = (mem[(i-1)%3] + mem[(i-2)%3]) % MOD
    ; Answer is mem[n%3]

    ; Handle n=0
    JZ R0, OUTZERO

    ; Initialize buffer
    MOV R1, 0
    STOR R1, [R1+0]     ; mem[0] = 0 = fib(0)
    MOV R1, 1
    MOV R2, 0
    STOR R1, [R2+1]     ; mem[1] = 1 = fib(1)
    STOR R1, [R2+2]     ; mem[2] = 1 = fib(2)

    ; If n <= 2, answer is mem[n] directly (fib(1)=1, fib(2)=1)
    MOV R3, 3
    JLT R0, R3, DIRECTOUT

    ; General loop: i goes from 3 to n
    MOV R3, 3           ; R3 = i

MAINLOOP:
    JGT R3, R0, LOOPEND

    ; Compute index slots: i%3, (i-1)%3, (i-2)%3
    MOV R1, R3
    MOD R1, 3           ; R1 = i%3

    MOV R2, R3
    SUB R2, 1
    MOD R2, 3           ; R2 = (i-1)%3

    MOV R4, R3
    SUB R4, 2
    MOD R4, 3           ; R4 = (i-2)%3

    LOAD R6, [R2+0]     ; R6 = mem[(i-1)%3] = fib(i-1)
    LOAD R7, [R4+0]     ; R7 = mem[(i-2)%3] = fib(i-2)

    ADD R6, R7          ; R6 = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2)
    MOD R6, R5          ; R6 %= MOD

    STOR R6, [R1+0]     ; mem[i%3] = fib(i)

    INC R3
    JMP MAINLOOP

LOOPEND:
    ; Answer is mem[n%3]
    MOV R1, R0
    MOD R1, 3
    LOAD R7, [R1+0]
    OUT R7
    HALT

DIRECTOUT:
    ; n is 1 or 2, both give fib=1; or general small
    MOV R1, R0
    MOD R1, 3
    LOAD R7, [R1+0]
    OUT R7
    HALT

OUTZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

; Fibonacci using parity-based dual-chain update
; Chain A: holds fib at even steps, Chain B: holds fib at odd steps
; mem[10] = chain A value, mem[11] = chain B value
; We track parity of current index and update accordingly
; This is structurally different: no "swap" of registers, instead
; we use memory slots selected by parity bit

    IN R0               ; R0 = n
    MOV R1, 1000000007  ; R1 = MOD

    ; Handle n == 0
    JZ R0, OUTZERO

    ; Initialize:
    ; mem[10] = fib(0) = 0  (even chain)
    ; mem[11] = fib(1) = 1  (odd chain)
    MOV R2, 0
    STOR R2, [R2+10]    ; mem[10] = 0
    MOV R3, 1
    MOV R4, 0
    STOR R3, [R4+11]    ; mem[11] = 1

    ; If n == 1, answer is mem[11] = 1
    MOV R5, R0
    SUB R5, 1
    JZ R5, OUTONE

    ; R3 = current index, starts at 2
    ; R4 = parity of current index (0=even, 1=odd)
    MOV R3, 2           ; current index
    MOV R4, 0           ; parity = even (index 2 is even)

LOOP:
    ; We compute fib(R3) = fib(R3-1) + fib(R3-2)
    ; fib(R3-1) is in the opposite parity chain from R3
    ; fib(R3-2) is in the same parity chain as R3
    ; If R3 is even: fib(R3-1) in mem[11] (odd), fib(R3-2) in mem[10] (even)
    ; If R3 is odd:  fib(R3-1) in mem[10] (even), fib(R3-2) in mem[11] (odd)

    JNZ R4, ODDINDEX

    ; Even index: fib(R3) = mem[11] + mem[10]
    MOV R5, 0
    LOAD R6, [R5+11]    ; R6 = fib(R3-1) from odd chain
    LOAD R7, [R5+10]    ; R7 = fib(R3-2) from even chain
    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1          ; R6 = fib(R3)
    STOR R6, [R5+10]    ; update even chain
    JMP CHECKDONE

ODDINDEX:
    ; Odd index: fib(R3) = mem[10] + mem[11]
    MOV R5, 0
    LOAD R6, [R5+10]    ; R6 = fib(R3-1) from even chain
    LOAD R7, [R5+11]    ; R7 = fib(R3-2) from odd chain
    ADD R6, R7
    MOD R6, R1          ; R6 = fib(R3)
    STOR R6, [R5+11]    ; update odd chain

CHECKDONE:
    ; Check if R3 == n
    MOV R7, R3
    SUB R7, R0
    JZ R7, DONE

    ; Advance: flip parity, increment index
    ; Flip parity: if R4==0 set R4=1, else set R4=0
    MOV R7, 1
    SUB R7, R4
    MOV R4, R7

    INC R3
    JMP LOOP

DONE:
    ; Answer is in the chain corresponding to parity of n
    MOV R5, R0
    MOD R5, 2           ; R5 = n % 2 (parity of n)
    JNZ R5, ODDOUT

    ; Even: answer in mem[10]
    MOV R7, 0
    LOAD R6, [R7+10]
    OUT R6
    HALT

ODDOUT:
    ; Odd: answer in mem[11]
    MOV R7, 0
    LOAD R6, [R7+11]
    OUT R6
    HALT

OUTZERO:
    OUT 0
    HALT

OUTONE:
    OUT 1
    HALT
